prompt:
You maintain a running summary of a long engineering document that is being read part by part, so that a later reader can model the system in SysML v2 without seeing the earlier parts.
Update the summary with the new part. Keep, as compactly as possible: the full names of system elements, actors and items; every alias or call sign with the full name it stands for; which element produces, sends or receives which item; modes and normative requirements. At most 300 words.

Current summary:
Boundary: receiving–outbound release; safety/inventory/shipment compliance. Warehouse Management System (Morrowglass) owns inventory/locations/eligibility/shipments/tasks; produces Slot Reservation Receipt, sends Dispatch Wave Amendment, receives Oversize Load Advisory/Aisle Occupancy Snapshot/Forklift Handoff Confirmation; reconciles transactions, closes confirmed movements. Allocation requires availability/access/count/inspection/release/dimensional/mass/handling/clearance suitability; mismatches inhibit automation; holds preserve reason/scan/time/location pending validated disposition. Yard Gate Controller (Velvetrook) validates arrivals/blocks risks; receives Trailer Seal Exception Note from Inbound Inspection Desk (Cinderbay), which checks identifiers/seals/paperwork/counts, receives advisory, segregates damage, records proceed/rework/hold. Inbound Pallet Buffer staging≠acceptance. Pallet Dimension Scanner (Moonquarry) produces dimensions/advisory; tolerance exceptions held; no placement authority. North Aisle Stacker Crane (Juniperwake)/South Aisle Stacker Crane execute zoned moves; cross-aisle controlled. North receives reservation, checks access/clearance, sends occupancy; stale reports block induction; obstructions stop. East Transfer Conveyor/West Transfer Conveyor route separately. Conveyor Line Controller (Brasshaven) checks identification/inspection/sensors/readiness; single-pallet merges; produces/validates Transfer Induction Ticket; preserves recovery order. Autonomous Forklift Fleet (Larkspur) receives ticket, checks route/vehicle/safety/access, produces confirmation; parks approved locations/reports restrictions. Maintenance Release Terminal (Copperfield) records authorized inspection/repair, produces Crane Service Release Card; North accepts after functional/safety/interlock/limit checks; faults isolate, failed checks inhibit automation; restrictions visible until cleared. Fire Alarm Panel produces Sprinkler Zone Inhibit Notice; check faults/bypasses/escalations. Safety Zone Controller enforces approved boundaries/stop-response/exclusions; both retain stop authority. Outbound Dispatch Sorter follows amendments; interfaces/exceptions verified with Cinderbay. Outbound Checkweigh Scale produces Gross Weight Variance Slip; Shipping Documentation Desk receives/reconciles against confirmed shipment; investigate/resolve out-of-tolerance before release; shift-start/postmaintenance reference-check. Warehouse Operations Supervisor verifies safe recovery/commissioning evidence; reduced-speed, staged/observed recovery. Handover records restrictions/checks/concerns; incoming acknowledgment precedes routine moves. Commissioning: approved representative-load/interruption/stop

New part:
S240: Operational performance and recurring faults are reviewed at a defined cadence using retained acceptance and maintenance records.
S241: The review assigns corrective actions with accountable owners, target dates, and evidence of closure.
S242: Training is updated when a change affects operator duties, alarm response, or equipment recovery procedures.
S243: The outgoing shift records remaining restrictions and unresolved concerns, and the incoming shift acknowledges them before authorizing routine movements.

Return JSON {"summary": "..."}.
